name: John Sweeney
message:
Hi
I have an enquiry if you guys need anyone with heavy plant experience. I am an RFS member and have completed online basic training but have been trying for years to complete basic practical firefighting without success due to scheduling. I have had 40 years operating & managing heavy plant in a large range of applications including trainer assessor for all of the large name OEM's. I also hold the PUAFIR417 supervise machinery use in wildfire operations qualification. I have a fair bit of mines rescue and advanced 1st aid experience over the years and fire fighting training in coal mines.
Not as mobile as I once was due to knee replacements but may be able to offer heavy plant supervision & training if it was of assistance. I am 56 years old.
Thanks
John Sweeney
0429 0700 10

name: Annika Ernest
message: Hi, I am reaching out in the hope of connecting with Captain Sandi Love. I work for Mint Renewables, the developer of the proposed Magpie Hill Solar Farm, and would welcome the opportunity to introduce myself and discuss the proposed Project.
